description: Enhance the client generator documentation to include JSDoc support for the distinct option in find operations. This should be implemented for both JavaScript and TypeScript client generators to provide clear documentation for developers using these query methods.
functional_requirements: Add JSDoc documentation for the distinct option in findMany operations within the JavaScript client generator
Extend JSDoc support for distinct option to findFirst and findFirstOrThrow operations in the TypeScript client generator
Ensure the documentation clearly explains the purpose and usage of the distinct option for filtering unique results
Maintain consistency between JavaScript and TypeScript generator implementations where applicable
